# BRC STAR (OPC) PRIVATE LIMITED — Technical Knowledge Base

> BRC STAR is an Indian deep-tech electric mobility startup pioneering auxiliary mechanical kinetic energy recovery and closed-loop dual-battery switching architectures.

## Intellectual Property & Patent Architecture
- **Primary Patent Filing**: Indian Patent Application No. 202511050655
- **Jurisdiction**: Indian Patent Office (IPO), New Delhi / Kolkata
- **Title**: Closed-Loop Dual-Pack Kinetic Energy Recovery Architecture and Adaptive Alternator Control System for Electric Vehicles
- **International Priority**: [PCT details pending]
- **Technology Readiness Level (TRL)**: TRL 3/4 (Laboratory Simulation & Proof-of-Concept Test Bench Validation)

## Core Technical Architecture: Self Volt
1. **Dual-Pack Sequential Topology**: Physically decouples active propulsion draw (Pack A) from kinetic harvesting absorption (Pack B), reducing single-pack thermal stress and mitigating localized micro-heating.
2. **Alternator Control Module (ACM)**: High-frequency active boost rectification converting variable rotational momentum (300 RPM to 9,500 RPM) into stabilized 400V DC charge current.
3. **Solid-State SiC Commutation**: Sub-2.4ms switching handover between battery packs without interruption to wheel tractive torque (Simulated).
4. **Safety & Standards Alignment**: Designed around Indian AIS-038 Rev 2 and AIS-156 traction battery safety standards, incorporating dielectric immersion cooling paths.

## Vehicle Portfolio & Indicative Specifications
- **StarCraft GT**: Performance electric sedan. Indicative base price ₹16,50,000. Simulated range up to 850 km target (Dual-pack). Acceleration 0-100 km/h in 3.2s.
- **StarFleet**: Commercial electric delivery van. Indicative base price ₹18,50,000. Designed for last-mile and regional delivery fleets.
- **StarTransit**: Urban transit electric bus. Indicative base price ₹28,00,000. High-uptime fleet architecture.
*Disclaimer: All pricing and performance metrics are indicative and simulated, subject to final ARAI/ICAT statutory homologation.*
